title: NTV Android TV v1.3
changelog:
• Recent Channels & Quick Recall: Auto-tracks recently played channels in '🕒 Recent' category and instant previous channel switch via remote key.
• Sleek Mini Channel Surfing Banner: Bottom zapping pill with channel logo, live progress bar, next show preview, and aspect badge without darkening the screen.
• Live Number Key Dialing Overlay: On-screen keypad entry with real-time matched channel preview and instant OK confirmation.
• Right-Pane Live & Upcoming Preview: Genre-based ambient glow (Sports, Movies, News, Zee/ClearKey) and UP NEXT schedule card.
• Aspect Ratio Quick Toggle: Cycle FIT (original), STRETCH (full-screen 16:9), and ZOOM modes with remote Yellow key or OSD badge.
• D-Pad Focus Enhancements: Smooth focus elevation with genre-tinted focus border and accent strip.
